title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29716v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7

translated_title: Fin-RSI：面向大语言模型智能体的金融技能、检查与自我提升统一库
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型能力的不断增强，金融智能体需要能够便捷发现和使用的工具。然而，金融软件分散在不同的库中，且这些库具有不同的接口和约定，这使得构建可靠的智能体工作流变得困难。我们提出了Fin-RSI，这是一个专为LLM智能体设计的统一Python库，涵盖金融技能、检查机制和自我提升功能。它通过跨模型和智能体框架的共享接口，将市场分析、预测、投资组合构建和交易研究等工具整合在一起。智能体可以从自然语言请求中找到合适的工具，复用经过测试的实现，并通过检查和反馈来改进生成的程序。开发者可以扩展该库以添加新工具，而无需为每个模型重新构建集成。在六项交易头寸任务中对20个开源权重模型的实验中，工具发现机制将产生有效程序的回合比例从9.7显著提升。
tldr: Fin-RSI是一个专为LLM金融智能体设计的统一Python库，通过共享接口整合了金融技能、检查机制和自我提升功能，显著提高了智能体在交易任务中生成有效程序的比例。
en_tdlr: Fin-RSI is a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement for LLM agents, which integrates tools through shared interfaces and significantly increases the proportion of agents producing valid programs on trading tasks.
